description: This header file defines the InputConnectionsProvider class within the cuttlefish namespace, which provides an interface for accessing input device connection file descriptors such as rotary device, mouse, keyboard, switches, touchscreen, and touchpad connections.

classes.name: InputConnectionsProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that provides an interface for obtaining input device connection file descriptors, including rotary device, mouse, keyboard, switches, touchscreen, and touchpad connections.

methods.name: ~InputConnectionsProvider
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the InputConnectionsProvider class.

methods.name: RotaryDeviceConnection
methods.description: Returns a SharedFD representing the rotary device connection.

methods.name: MouseConnection
methods.description: Returns a SharedFD representing the mouse connection.

methods.name: KeyboardConnection
methods.description: Returns a SharedFD representing the keyboard connection.

methods.name: SwitchesConnection
methods.description: Returns a SharedFD representing the switches connection.

methods.name: TouchscreenConnections
methods.description: Returns a vector of SharedFD objects representing touchscreen connections.

methods.name: TouchpadConnections
methods.description: Returns a vector of SharedFD objects representing touchpad connections.
